info.title: Ouranos platform API
info.description: Connected travel platform. Supabase bearer authentication, organization isolation, versioned commands, synchronization, human Authorization approval, and immutable automatic Voucher verification. A successful Ouranos verification is not DTS acceptance or DoD approval.

post.description: Use commandId in the body as the idempotency key; the Idempotency-Key HTTP header is not read. Reuse the entire unchanged command when retrying a lost response. expectedVersion is 0 for creation and the current entity version for updates. A deviceId belongs to one user in one organization. Custom date/order, duplicate-expense and final-approver refinements are enforced by Zod at runtime in addition to the generated JSON Schema.
